offering_description.value: Provides strategic advisory, benchmarking, and digital transformation consulting to large enterprises, focused on finance, procurement, HR, IT and supply chain functions. Also offers generative AI and enterprise performance software, plus subscription research and benchmarking memberships. Delivered by consultants and through its research and software platforms.

primary_products.value: benchmarking and research subscriptions; AI and analytics software platforms; enterprise performance management software

primary_services.value: management consulting; digital transformation; ERP implementation (Oracle, SAP, OneStream); benchmarking; AI advisory

customer_segment.value: B2B: large corporations and multinational enterprises, mainly their finance, procurement, HR, IT and supply chain executives

end_markets.value: financial services; consumer goods; manufacturing; healthcare; technology; energy

revenue_model.value: project or contract: consulting and implementation engagements, time-and-materials or fixed fee; subscription: benchmarking and research memberships, software access; service fees: advisory and managed services
revenue_model.category: project or contract; subscription; service fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: consultants deliver advisory and implementation services to enterprise clients; software / platform: benchmarking, AI and analytics platforms sold to corporate clients

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other regions, with the US the largest market

specialization.value: related lines: consulting, benchmarking research, and enterprise software for business function performance

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams and executive relationships with enterprise clients; partners / resellers: alliances with software vendors such as Oracle, SAP and OneStream

regulatory_exposure.value: low: professional services subject to normal business and data privacy rules
